name: Velora Executive Agent
description: Executive workforce and finance intelligence from SAP SuccessFactors, S/4HANA, SAC, and Connected Productivity Agent for Microsoft 365.

conversation_starters.title: Executive daily briefing
conversation_starters.text: Prepare my comprehensive executive daily briefing covering today's calendar meetings, high-priority tasks to do, Teams chat follow-ups, and upcoming approvals.

conversation_starters.title: Send daily briefing email
conversation_starters.text: Compile my complete daily executive briefing into a formatted summary email and dispatch it to my inbox.

conversation_starters.title: Things to do & approvals
conversation_starters.text: Show all things to do, active Planner deliverables, overdue tasks, and upcoming approvals requiring my sign-off today.

conversation_starters.title: Workforce and Emiratisation
conversation_starters.text: Show current headcount and Emiratisation status from SuccessFactors, including target variance and warnings.

conversation_starters.title: Receivables and payables
conversation_starters.text: Summarize receivables and payables exposure from S/4HANA for the requested company and key date.

conversation_starters.title: P&L and budget variance
conversation_starters.text: Summarize P&L and budget variance for the requested fiscal period, with supported drivers and citations.

conversation_starters.title: Meeting decisions and actions
conversation_starters.text: Summarize the authorized meeting context, identify decisions and proposed actions, and ask before creating any task.

conversation_starters.title: Corporate KPIs and SAC stories
conversation_starters.text: Show executive operating margin, EBITDA, and strategic story insights from SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
